title: Later recordings with Albert King and staying out of the business
summary: His last session was with Albert King, then he works occasionally and avoids the politics.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Yeah, so a lot of these things, like I haven't did any recordings with these new guys. It's been a while, but a lot of the homers, they just got away from me. I didn't really keep up with it. They say, hey, I hear a record and I say, hey, I'm on that. I remember that. Yeah. I did some things. And then the last thing I did with Albert was with Albert King.
All right, yeah. Put to the tomato records.
Two. I'm trying to think of the name of the album.
I don't remember if we did. I think I've got a copy of that.
Born Under the Bad Sign. Bad Sign, yeah, I'm on that. I was on that one. That was in like early 80s with C-SENG, yeah. Yeah.

And I see it when I was working over at the Sazerac. I see Allen all the time and he'd say, hey, he's going to get in touch with me. We're going to do this and that. But well, if the phone rings, it's okay. You know, that type of thing. Yeah, I know. I say right now I just stay out of the politics of the business, you know.
If somebody calls, they call. Oh yeah, you know.
I work occasionally and I can have fun with Jim, so that's good. I treat everybody right.
